CustomField.description: Calculates the Monthly Recurring Revenue for the Quote Line Item by multiplying the Quantity by the Net Unit Price.
CustomField.formula: IF( PricingTermCount > 0, /* MSAP Per User (service): pair with MSAP Licensing 001-CYBR-LIC-SAPX-KNB4-001 */ IF( Product2.StockKeepingUnit = "001-CYBR-SVC-SAPX-USER-002", ROUND( NetUnitPrice * Quantity + BLANKVALUE( Quote.Managed_Security_Licensing_Total__c, 0 ), 0 ) - ROUND( BLANKVALUE( Quote.Managed_Security_Licensing_Total__c, 0 ), 0 ), /* Monitoring Services (service): pair with Monitoring License 001-INFR-LIC-MONI-LOMO-001 */ IF( Product2.StockKeepingUnit = "001-INFR-SVC-MONI-DEVC-001", ROUND( NetUnitPrice * Quantity + BLANKVALUE( Quote.Monitoring_Licensing_Total__c, 0 ), 0 ) - ROUND( BLANKVALUE( Quote.Monitoring_Licensing_Total__c, 0 ), 0 ), /* every other SKU, including both licensing SKUs: unchanged */ NetUnitPrice * Quantity ) ), 0 )
CustomField.label: MRR
